title: synthetic-data
summary: A personal Jupyter-notebook project exploring synthetic tabular data generation, covering data quality diagnostics, model customization, and synthetic sample evaluation. It imports SDV's single-table synthesizers (GaussianCopula, CTGAN, CopulaGAN) and evaluation utilities, and separately imports the copulas library directly, to fit models and run diagnostic and quality reports on generated data.
